relations.subject: Józef Kowalewski
relations.evidence: He was allowed to study at the Kazan University, where he studied Mongolia, particularly the Mongolian language and Tibetan Buddhism.

relations.subject: Józef Kowalewski
relations.object: Department of Mongolian Studies at Kazan University
relations.evidence: In 1833, he founded the Department of Mongolian Studies at Kazan University – the first in Europe.

relations.subject: Józef Kowalewski
relations.role: dean of the Philological and Historical Faculty
relations.evidence: he became the dean of the Philological and Historical Faculty of the University of Warsaw.
